import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Remove exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)
    
    # Fix case variants in 'species' and 'sex'
    df['species'] = df['species'].str.capitalize()
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].str.strip()
    
    # Fix out-of-range body_mass_g (4600000 is way above max 6500)
    # Also fix negative flipper_length_mm (-196)
    df.loc[df['body_mass_g'] > 6500, 'body_mass_g'] = pd.NA
    df.loc[df['flipper_length_mm'] < 0, 'flipper_length_mm'] = pd.NA
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    df_clean = clean(df)
    return df_clean['island'].value_counts().to_dict()
